source_scope: Previously used training coordinates and seeds. Four-cylinder source scene is unchanged; three-cylinder scene is newly derived by removing the other-slot singleton. No independence, unused historical seed or closed-test disjointness is certified.
selection_rule: For each ordered direction, take source 4-cylinder tower registrations r1..r4. Use r1,r2 unchanged for four cylinders; for r3,r4 remove the singleton from the other slots to construct three-cylinder towers. Alternate replicate-to-allocation by direction and count. Use only the first move; pilot directions are 1->2, 1->3, 2->1 and 3->4 with one case per count and opposite allocations.
scope_reason: n4_s2_d2_other01 is one of the 1103 checkpoint training groups. n3_s2_d2_other00 was not in those eight groups and is explicitly newly exposed for future candidate training; after training, repeated 216 cases of this structure are exposed development conditions, not held-out evaluation.
notes: Use only public registered scene/task/slots, joint observations, nominal FK, prior confirmed applied targets/actions for the handoff and teacher actions.
The three-cylinder tower group is newly exposed, not a previously trained 1103 group; its repeated 216 results after candidate training are exposed development results.
A normal or stall-risk allocation may be untriggered; at 40 confirmed student commands hand off as fallback_untriggered, never report this as realized stall.
Early student DONE, command refusal, interruption, unconfirmed result and teacher failure stay in the denominator; never synthesize a teacher label.
A train-range seed does not prove historical nonuse or independence; these start conditions are based on already used registrations.
Operator/model identity is not independently verified; preserve the official direct submission transcript separately.
Simulation only; no closed final test or real hardware. This local plan is not a trusted timestamp.

future_evaluation.scope: Use the already completed public 1103 tower 24-session development set for a same-budget control/candidate comparison after training; distinguish first move, full three moves, three/four cylinders, non-target checks and unconfirmed cases.
future_evaluation.interpretation: Exposed development comparison; no closed final starts or outcomes become teacher labels.
